0022600201.text: The Clippers (1-7, 1-3 at home) are on a seven-game losing streak and sit 13th in the West and fourth in the Pacific, six games back, while the New Orleans Pelicans (4-5) have lost their last game and are 11th in the West and fifth in the Southwest, three games back. The Clippers are listed as out Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and the Pelicans are listed as out Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Clippers lost their last meeting 105-99 in New Orleans on March 19, 2026, while this season's series has no games yet.
